column3: Pink in the sink, every time you brush?
Meet Moti. A happy little molar, living a happy little life.
Until one morning... a little blood.
Everyone said, it's normal. So Moti ignored it.
But plaque hardened into tartar, and the gums got angry. Red. Swollen. Bleeding.
Then they started pulling away. And Moti began to wobble!
That's when Moti met Doctor Sri Sushma, a gum specialist.
One deep cleaning later, the tartar was gone, the gums calmed down, and Moti held strong again.
Bleeding gums are an early sign of gum disease. Don't wait for the wobble.
